content.title: Pokémon Champions: Release date, times, platforms, full Pokémon list & trailers
content.text: After being announced all the way back in early 2025, the release date for Pokémon Champions is nearly here — coming to a couple of specific platforms at certain times, depending on your timezone.What's more, along with Pocket Monsters you can use from other games via Pokémon Home, Pokémon Champions has a full list of Pokémon you can access in the game to use as well.Along with what Pokémon are natively available, what the game is coming, and when it will be arriving on other platforms, here is everything we know about Pokémon Champions so far.When is the Pokémon Champions release date?Pokémon Champions. YouTube/ Nintendo of AmericaThe release date for Pokémon Champions is Wednesday 8 April 2026, on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch consoles, as confirmed during the March Pokémon Present.As well as this, Nintendo confirmed that on release day, players will be able to get their hands on a Starter Pack bundle that includes extra benefits like more Pokémon storage space, an extra battle song and more.Both an Android and iOS mobile release is also in development, but will launch at a later date.What times does Pokémon Champions come out?Fan Pokemon website Serebii has shared on X (formerly Twitter), that the Pokemon Company has confirmed Pokemon Champions will release at around 3am UTC on 8 April.This means will release at the following times in various timezones:8pm PDT (April 7)4AM BST (April 8)11PM EDT (April 7)4am CET (April 8)12pm JST (Aprl 8)12am BRT (April 8)1pm AET (April 8)What is Pokémon Champions?Pokémon Champions. YouTube/Nintendo of AmericaPokémon Champions is a free-to-start, turn-based strategy spin-off built to focus entirely on Pokémon battles rather than a dedicated open-world RPG.Developed by The Pokémon Works in collaboration with Game Freak, it centres on online competition, with Ranked, Casual, and Private Battles available in both Single and Double formats. Players can put together teams by recruiting Pokémon in-game or by bringing certain partners over through Pokémon Home (from Scarlet & Violet, Legends: Z-A, FireRed & LeafGreen, etc), while cross-platform play is planned across Nintendo Switch and mobile.Along with supporting major power-up mechanics from mainline games via the player's Omni Ring — Mega Evolution, Z-moves, Gigantamax, Dynamax, and Terastallization — Champions is replacing the use of the latest mainline Pokémon games at official Play!Pokemon VGC events, like the Pokemon World Championships; with that, players can consistently take part in the competitive scene without having to start over every few years with the newest title, as Champions can simply update its meta with the latest mechanics as the meta evolves with new games.Want to see this content?This page contains content provided by Google reCAPTCHA. YouTube/ The Official Pokémon YouTube channelAfter launching on both Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch consoles on 8 April, Pokémon Champions will also be released on iOS and Android mobile devices later this year.Does Pokémon Champions have an iOS & Android mobile release date?Pokémon Champions. YouTube/ The Official Pokémon YouTube channelThe mobile phone versions of Pokémon Champions on iOS and Android have not been given a specific release date yet, but the ports are definitely coming out later in 2026; we expect to be given a specific date after the Nintendo Switch consoles' launch.This can usually be the case with multi-platform games, as developers sometimes want to hold off on giving specifics about additional ports in case the first needs some quick post-launch updates. Nevertheless, we will be updating this guide as soon as we know more.Full list of available Pokémon in ChampionsPokémon Champions. YouTube/Nintendo of AmericaConfirmed by Serebii, Pokémon Champions has 162 Pokémon that are available to rent in the game by recruiting for free and spending Victory Points — instead of using those
